name: The Flame's Casing
summary: After Forging the Shaft, Kalaran Windblade says one final piece is needed for the torch. A large Twilight's Hammer encampment lies to the northwest, rumored to hold symbols and idols honoring its god, and Kalaran wants a single Symbol of Ragnaros.

sections.title: A Piece for the Casing
sections.body: Kalaran calls this the last piece the torch needs. Northwest, among the mountains, a large Twilight's Hammer encampment is rumored to hold symbols and idols honoring their god, and these could carry enough enchantment for a magical casing. Kalaran asks for one Symbol of Ragnaros and will try to draw the magic out of it. The torch of retribution lacks one thing, a suitable source of arcane energy.

sections.title: The Symbol Examined
sections.body: The symbol gives off a foul magic, which Kalaran finds ideal for the work.

faq.q: What is needed to create the flame's casing?
faq.answer: Kalaran Windblade asks for a single Symbol of Ragnaros, from which magic may be drawn to form the casing.

faq.q: Where is the Twilight's Hammer encampment?
faq.answer: Kalaran says a large Twilight's Hammer encampment lies in the mountains to the northwest.

faq.q: Why does Kalaran want a Symbol of Ragnaros?
faq.answer: The symbols and idols of Twilight's Hammer could carry enough enchantment to form a magical casing, and Kalaran hopes to draw that magic out of one.

faq.q: What comes before this step in the chain?
faq.answer: It follows Forging the Shaft, in which Kalaran asked for thorium plated daggers to reforge into a shaft.
